snippet.title: [Yakouga 3] 100% Run. All Items. Good Ending. All Maps Explored.
snippet.description:
This game is a hidden gem. Developer clearly went full in, and created as much content as he could.
Just look at the maps that I check before last boss, this will give you an idea, how complex it is.
What’s more, enemies and item’s effects and position are very well balanced, to both have value and be challenging to obtain.
I honestly would give this game at least 9/10, it has very nice art style, music, atmosphere, challenges and gameplay overall.
The only thing that holds this game down is view range, that is somewhat unfair and doesn’t give time to react to certain fast enemies. Still, it’s awesome in every other way.


This game is very hard by itself, so this time I’m just doing 100% run without any additional challenges.
Killing all enemies is pointless, since they respawn very fast.
Not taking damage at all is impossible, due to different hazards, like water.
And avoiding all enemies is random and somewhat unfair because of small field of view.
So, I decided to simply avoid big mistakes and was fine with taking damage from time to time, while still trying to use weapons effectively and having perfect route.

About saves - I saved often not only because game is hard, but because of technical difficulties. After playing for some time (~5 minutes), game gradually loses framerate and slows down. That is unacceptable for quality recording.

Small notes:
– Secret boss is killed before fire breath is picked up, because using it makes the boss rage.
– Game can be finished without wings, after getting Winged Boots and Emblem 8. Last boss won’t appear and there will be different epilogue - shorter and with no extra art. Decided to skip it entirely.
– I’m not entirely sure, why there is a purple crystal and an empty (boss?) room at the end of bullet hell sequence, and why there is some weird looking block at the top. Clearly, there are no more items to pick up and even game itself says, that it was 100% completed. But I still somehow feel that I missed something. If anyone knows for sure please, tell me.
